narr: Monsoon moisture over northern Ariozna, very weak steering flow, and westerly winds provided ventilation aloft leading to slow-moving thunderstorms with locally heavy rain and flash flooding.
ev: The rive guage on Granite Creek in Prescott measured over a 6.5 foot rise in one hour betweeb 400 PM and 500 PM. The creek slowly dropped to near normal levels by 500 AM early the next morning.
lsr: [Delayed Report] Over 6.5 foot rise in Granite Creek at Prescott gauge.
